entries.description: Turn the charm all the way up while it lasts.

entries.name: Persuade

entries.name: Misdirect

entries.name: Keep a Straight Face
entries.description: Give nothing away under questioning.

entries.name: Impersonate
entries.description: Pass yourself off as someone else.

entries.name: Intimidate
entries.description: Make someone afraid of what you might do.

entries.name: Stare Down
entries.description: Win a silent contest of wills.

entries.name: Issue an Ultimatum
entries.description: Leave someone a hard choice.

entries.name: Interrogate
entries.description: Press someone hard for answers.

entries.name: Compel Obedience
entries.description: Make someone do whatever you say.
entries.exclusionReason: Would let a check dictate another character's choices outright; the engine rules outcomes, not wills. Intimidate and Persuade cover the honest version.

entries.name: Read Body Language
entries.description: Watch someone's tells.

entries.name: Sense Motive

entries.name: Read the Room
entries.description: Gauge the mood of everyone present.

entries.name: Read Minds
entries.description: Hear someone's thoughts directly.
entries.exclusionReason: Needs hidden mental state the engine does not track; telepathy belongs with the magic archetypes (S12) if anywhere.

entries.name: Observe Protocol

entries.name: Speak a Foreign Language
entries.description: Converse in a language you know.
entries.exclusionReason: Languages are better modelled as story flags and lore than as checks with DCs (plan 09 §4.2).
